items.name: Spec Compliance
items.note: All six MIS-1 acceptance criteria are implemented in the existing Mission data and presentation layers.

items.name: Error Handling
items.note: Unreadable or incomplete artifact data degrades to explicit unavailable states rather than fabricated values.

items.name: Security Basics
items.note: Requirement sources use server-minted document identifiers; the client does not construct paths.

items.name: Test Quality
items.note: Focused server and rendered client tests cover lifecycle, source order, terminal identity, count validity, and header layout invariants.

items.name: Performance Basics
items.note: Resolver cache identity includes terminal state and all reads remain bounded existing artifact reads.

items.name: Naming & Structure
items.note: Changes follow existing MissionContext, artifact-builder, and Mission component boundaries.

items.name: Affected Boundaries
items.note: The existing server/client MissionContext wire mirror is updated and parity-tested; no producer contract changed.
